metadata.evaluation_name: Register Effects on Tail Shape, Corrected Unit
metadata.description: Corrected decile-level paired tests, GPD xi vs power-law alpha tail models, and stratified/robustness analyses of the spoken-vs-written dependency-distance register effect across 4 matched UD treebank pairs and 18 treebanks total.
